title: Computer Gaming World
description: The longest-running American computer game magazine. Started as a bimonthly wargaming-focused newsletter in 1981, became the paper of record for PC gaming under Ziff Davis, and closed with issue 268 in November 2006 before relaunching as Games for Windows: The Official Magazine.

title: Computer Game Forum
description: Short-lived CGW sister title. Hosted by the CGW Museum.

title: Electronic Games
description: The first video game magazine (1981-85); revived 1992-95.

title: Games for Windows: The Official Magazine
description: Direct successor to Computer Gaming World; hosted by the CGW Museum.

title: GamesMaster
